_doc: Level XP (scripts/match/xp_rules.gd, docs/decisions/0048-camps-and-xp.md). XP is a kill reward: nothing over time, nothing for damage (damage to Hunters only builds armor). share_r (m): the last hit's squadmates, alive or downed, this close to the killer get the same XP in full. knock: base + per_level x the victim's level, plus per_level_above for each level the victim is above the knocker, times below_k when the victim is below_gap or more levels under the knocker. camp_mob: a camp monster's XP by kind (a camp's XP is the sum of its monsters; chief is the Camp Chief's Brute). stray: any other monster (the Blight's, wanderers, lair guards); lair bosses pay through lairs.gd. comeback: a camp monster pays its XP x k to a squad whose average run level is gap or more under the top squad still in (the camp shows a comeback tag on that squad's maps); never from time, never from Hunters. pace_at_s[i]: the match second from which the pace level is i + 1 (the level a squad that plays camps and objectives well has then; bots farm at or below it).
